title: tragacantha schrenkiana
intro: Tragacantha schrenkiana, commonly known as Schrenk's milkvetch or Schrenk's astragalus, is a plant species in the pea family Fabaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha schrenkiana include its ability to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
